Subject: Request: Tax lifecycle checklist & PO entity mapping for Mercator Systems (EU)

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To move vendor setup and PO activation along on our side we need a short set of tax/corporate items so we can: (1) validate your EU VAT status, (2) decide which Redwood legal entity the PO should be assigned to, and (3) confirm whether the invoice should be processed under reverse-charge or with VAT.

Could you please provide the following within the next 3 business days: 
- Company extract / registration (attachment or PDF)
- Official EU VAT registration number (we need the exact format you report to tax authorities)
- A VAT certificate or equivalent document signed by your finance team
- Bank remit details and the legal name you prefer on our PO (this determines entity/GL mapping on our side)

Im attaching a short vendor_tax_onboarding_form.xlsx to capture the exact fields we need (legal name, VAT ID, tax representative if applicable, remit address, preferred PO entity). Once we have that we can issue PO # and confirm invoicing format.

Quick note on the PO: Redwood issues POs from multiple legal entities; for EU suppliers we usually map to our EU entity (well confirm which entity once we validate your VAT evidence). If reverse-charge is applicable we will expect an invoice that references the buyer's VAT number and the reverse-charge line. If not, we will process the VAT as invoiced.

Thanks — copying Laura (payments) and Ben (tax ops) for visibility.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie —

Received, thanks for the prompt turnaround and the attachments — Ive uploaded the certs to the intake ticket. A couple quick clarifications so we can finalize PO mapping and avoid invoice hold-ups:

- Entity on PO: Please confirm whether you want the PO issued to "Mercator Systems GmbH" (the German legal entity) — thats what we will use by default unless you tell us to route to a different branch entity.

- Reverse-charge: From our side, if Redwood will be the buyer under one of our EU legal entities (we typically use Redwood Inference Netherlands B.V. for EU procurements), reverse-charge will be the expected treatment for B2B services. For your invoice please: 
  - Show your VAT ID (DE123456789)
  - Show the buyer as "Redwood Inference Netherlands B.V." and include our VAT number (we will provide the exact VAT once legal confirms)
  - Add a line or note: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient (Article 196 EU VAT Directive)"
  - Do not charge German VAT if reverse-charge applies (leave VAT column blank/0 and write the reverse-charge note).

- Tax residency: The VAT certificate and company extract are sufficient for initial onboarding; if our tax team needs a signed tax residency affidavit we will request it separately (we try to minimize extra docs).

Im attaching an example invoice template (redwood_example_invoice.pdf) to show the fields that clear our PO activation checks. Once you confirm the legal name you want on the PO I will create PO #987654 and share the PDF.

Thanks,
Karthik
(attachment: redwood_example_invoice.pdf)

Sophie —

Short answers: 
- Withholding: For cross-border B2B services within the EU under reverse-charge, withholding typically does not apply. Our tax team will confirm if any country-specific withholding obligations arise (rare for services between EU companies). If a withholding obligation is identified well surface it before the first invoice.

- Fiscal representative: Not required for Germany when supplying B2B services where your company is already registered for VAT (your DE VAT ID will suffice).

Action items Ill do on our side: 
- Create PO #987654 and route to Mercator Systems GmbH (see attached po_987654.pdf)
- Mark onboarding checklist as pending final VAT verification (vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx)
- Share Redwoods EU VAT number via secure link once legal confirms (will post to the HubSpot deal and send DocuSign for any further declarations if needed)

Please confirm when youve updated your invoice template and well approve PO activation.

Thanks again — looking forward to the first invoice.

Karthik Iyer
